forecast.scope: the zones of the plan it was made with, and what is done already

draft:
During week 21 of May, teams completed 1 zone survey and 3 visits; no technical surveys or clearances were completed. So far, 15 zones have been surveyed, 2 declared free, 9 areas released and 4 cleared. Mines have been found in 1 area; 574 suspected or confirmed areas remain open.

Officer attention: 7 zones are closed according to the access feed. No teams were stood down or without a report for more than a week. No dossiers or reports were held or queried, and no new plan was approved; the plan remains P05.

The week 19 forecast, for the zones of the plan it was made with and counting what is already done, gives a P10 to P90 range of 10 to 13 mine areas cleared this season and 10 to 14 zones declared free this season.
